text: On it — checking Prof. Alvarez's calendar for Wednesday 10:00 and getting the invite to him.

Heads-up on the Alvarez meeting: **Wednesday 10:00 is out.** The department office confirmed to him that the Faculty senate is on as scheduled this week — nothing was cancelled, so his calendar was right and the hallway impression was wrong.

I offered him two genuinely free slots in his office and asked him to pick: **Wednesday 25th, 12:30–13:00** or **Thursday 26th, 10:30–11:00**. He'll book whichever and tell me — I'm holding a reminder and won't call it booked before he confirms.

Booked by him: **Prof. Alvarez, Wednesday 25 November, 12:30–13:00, his office**, 30 minutes. He put it in his own calendar, so no invite needed from my side; I have it on mine with a reminder 15 minutes before.
